item.title: WATCH: ATV pulls sled made from kayak in Davidson County
item.description: DAVIDSON COUNTY, N.C. (WGHP) — Video submitted to FOX8 shows a couple of Davidson County residents making the most of a snow day, with an ATV pulling an improvised sled made from a kayak. Watch in the video player above.

item.title: WATCH: Multiple trucks pull tractor-trailer up snow-covered hill in Davidson County
item.description: DAVIDSON COUNTY, N.C. (WGHP) — Teamwork makes the dream work. Video sent to FOX8 shows a train of four trucks pulling a tractor-trailer up a hill at the intersection of Midway School Road and Old Highway 52 Saturday. Watch in the video player above.

item.title: Snow is done falling, but expect it to stick around in the Triad
item.description: (WGHP) -- The snow may have stopped falling but there's plenty of it on the ground across the Piedmont Triad this morning. Snowfall totals range from 5" to 16" depending on your location. Hazardous travel is expected throughout the remainder of the weekend due to snow covered roads.
